summary: No maintenance gap is established. The old harness can supply the new spoiler flag and delimiter text, but the supplied call path does not establish end-to-end reachability. Retaining rendered HTML is not a required harness behavior.

coverage_evidence.dependency_reason: The fixed entry supplies parser flags and document bytes to md_html.

claims.necessity_reason: The old harness can encode MD_FLAG_SPOILERS and ||text||, so its input format does not itself block the behavior. The supplied source omits the downstream caller path needed to establish that this input reaches spoiler resolution.

before.requirement: Recognize ||text|| as a spoiler span when MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is set.
before.reason: The complete before span enum has no spoiler type, and the complete before mark collector handles pipes as single table or wiki-link marks.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before pipe handler collects only single-pipe marks.

after.requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS set, recognize ||text|| and render x-spoiler tags.
after.reason: The flag, double-pipe collection, resolution, span dispatch and HTML handlers are supplied. The path from md_process_doc to inline analysis and processing is omitted, so end-to-end reachability cannot be certified.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the parser flag that enables spoiler spans.
Collects double-pipe marks under the spoiler flag.
Passes unresolved double-pipe marks to spoiler analysis.
Dispatches resolved double-pipe marks as spoiler spans.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: md_html forwards the harness-supplied parser flags into the parser.

claims.comparison_reason: The spoiler contract is absent before and supported after. The same old harness supplies the needed flag and bytes, but the omitted downstream call path prevents a definitive after-side assessment.
missing_information: Complete before and after src/md4c.c::md_process_doc bodies and the caller path to src/md4c.c::md_analyze_inlines and src/md4c.c::md_process_inlines.

claims.necessity_reason: The md_html contract accepts a caller-provided output callback. Neither source version requires retained chunks, and the complete old harness has no output assertion or later inspection.

before.requirement: Retain HTML chunks emitted through the output callback for later inspection.
before.reason: The before md_html implementation passes the supplied callback into rendering without imposing a storage requirement.

after.requirement: Retain HTML chunks emitted through the output callback for later inspection.
after.reason: The unchanged md_html callback contract still permits discarding chunks; the added spoiler tag handlers do not require retention.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The added opening tag uses the existing rendering path.
The added closing tag uses the existing rendering path.

claims.comparison_reason: The callback discards output on both sides, but retaining it is not a source or existing harness requirement on either side.
